preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each n_i must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.
Each k_i must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^18.

postconditions.description: If it is possible to perform k_i splitting operations, output 'YES' and the log2 of the side length of the squares.
If it is not possible to perform k_i splitting operations, output 'NO'.
